title: Exact finite-free scalar extension preserves the constructible finite-Tor domain
statement: Let W be any scheme with its small pro-etale site. Let A and B be finite commutative rings, let B be an A-algebra, and let b be a basis of B over A indexed by Fin r for a natural number r [def-sf-finite-free-scalar-calculus-data]. If K is a bounded constructible complex of A-module sheaves of finite Tor amplitude [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude, def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], then the canonical derived scalar extension K tensor_A^L B is a bounded constructible complex of B-module sheaves of finite Tor amplitude. Scalar extension is the left adjoint of actual derived restriction [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility]. No Noetherian or finite-type hypothesis on W is required.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-finite-free-scalar-tensor-calculus] on the etale and pro-etale sites. It supplies exact extension and restriction, their exact derived functors, and the adjunction to actual derived restriction. Exact extension commutes with homology and preserves both cohomological bounds. Ordinary scalar extension preserves finite locally constant sheaves and their fixed finite stratifications: tensor the local constant modules with B; they remain finite because the coefficient rings and the original module are finite. This is the proved source-library instance ProEtale.isConstructibleSheaf_etaleSheafExtendScalars_obj. Hence exact etale scalar extension preserves bounded constructibility.

proof.text: The canonical ordinary scalar/site comparison localizes through exact extension. If K is the pro-etale realization of L, then its exact extension is the realization of the exact extension of L. Compose that comparison with extension of the original origin isomorphism; this gives the required bounded constructible etale origin.

proof.text: Choose a Tor interval [a,b] of K. For every degree-zero B-module sheaf F, [lem-sf-finite-free-scalar-derived-tensor-models] identifies derived restriction of the extended K tensor_B F with K tensor_A Res F. Restriction commutes with degree-zero complexes and homology, and reflects cohomological vanishing. Thus the same interval holds for the extension. Finally uniqueness of left adjoints identifies exact descent with the fixed derived tensor of [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility], and invariance under isomorphisms transfers the constructed domain proof.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteFreeTensorCtf (W : Scheme.{u})
    (A B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B] [Algebra A B]
    (r : ℕ) (basis : Module.Basis (Fin r) A B)
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology W) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
    (hK : ProEtale.DerivedCategory.constructibleFiniteTor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) W K) :
    ProEtale.DerivedCategory.constructibleFiniteTor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) W
      ((ProEtale.pbcFixedScalarExtension (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
        (algebraMap A B)).obj K)
